title: A magyar tudomány csillagai és a Nobel-díjasok
grammar: Honours and Discoveries: kitüntet, kivont, kifejlesztett

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name Hungarian Nobel Prize winners and say what they were awarded for.
I can say that someone was awarded a prize (*Nobel-díjjal tüntették ki*).
I can use words for science, research and discoveries.
I can read about Albert Szent-Györgyi, Katalin Karikó, and Ferenc Krausz.
